audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch. Distractor match requires overlap with an independently labelled other object. Missing and uncertain labels remain explicit; no physical or personal identity certification.

referenceMemory137.scope: Independent reference boxes and fully visible source annotations; original evidence reverified. Same-object declaration is supplied by the operator, not a semantic identity proof. No target predictions admitted.
referenceMemory137.declaration: Same declared generated target in separate source pixels; independently verified full reference boxes, not semantic identity proof.

appearance135.scope: Motion-cycle conditions are not identity truth. Separate labels score each admission and bank recovery; unlabelled/uncertain examples remain unknown. Initial seed is excluded from learned-example counts. Historical evidence retains its original source and code identity.

audit.scope: Independent target boxes and separately declared visibility score original runs. IoU failure is not automatically an identity switch.
